description: Compares the current JavaScript and TypeScript module graph with an existing trackable code graph. Preview is the default; applyMarkers updates only generated graph styling.

applyMarkers.description: When true, marks changed elements orange and stale elements red. Defaults to a read-only preview.

boardName.description: Board name under the target repository boards directory. Defaults to "main".

diagramId.description: Code graph diagram id to compare. Defaults to the newest trackable code graph on the board.

repoPath.description: Absolute or relative path to the repository. Defaults to the MCP server working directory.

name: compare_code_graph
title: Compare code graph drift
